_provenance: Real capture: POST https://agent-ready.dev/api/v1/a2a against a live production agent found via a2aregistry.org, 2026-07-07. Its public 'ask' skill (no API key required) gave a genuinely rich, real answer -- 8 relevant Schema.org-typed search results -- entirely as a single 'kind':'data' part, with no 'kind':'text' part at all. Motivated extending _extract_texts() to also serialize data parts: without it, a fully substantive answer was reported as empty content. Trimmed to 1 of 8 results for fixture brevity.
